Industrial B2B · CRM planning

CRM evaluation
and lead management.

A proposed qualification and follow-up model for an industrial technology business.

Role

Sales & Marketing Coordinator

Period

2024

Scope

CRM evaluation · Lead qualification · Sales and marketing handoff

01

Executive Summary

At Nett Technologies, I evaluated CRM options against the needs of Sales, Marketing and Operations. The work covered lead capture, account assignment, follow-up, reporting and integration with Genius ERP. I also mapped how inquiries could move through qualification, quotation and post-sale service. These were planning deliverables; adoption and revenue impact are not claimed.

02

Situation

Sales inquiries arrived through different channels, while customer information, opportunity status and follow-up needed a common structure. The CRM decision also had to account for the existing Genius ERP system.

03

Task

Give stakeholders a practical basis for CRM selection and a consistent process for qualifying and assigning incoming opportunities.

04

Action

  1. Define the requirements

    Documented lead capture, account ownership, follow-up, reporting and ERP integration needs.

  2. Compare CRM options

    Assessed six platforms against usability, workflow, integration, cost and onboarding criteria in a 2024 evaluation.

  3. Map lead qualification

    Developed account categories, BANT criteria and a lead-scoring model for sales prospecting.

  4. Connect the handoff

    Mapped the proposed path from inquiry and quote to order completion and post-sale follow-up.

05

Result

Deliverables: a CRM evaluation, lead-qualification framework and proposed sales-to-ERP funnel. Implementation or revenue impact has not been verified.

Strategic insight
